name: Apache Arrow
description: A cross-language development platform for in-memory columnar data.
summary: AI tools may be used to generate PRs, but authors should review and own every change, be upfront about what was AI-generated, and disclose any copyrighted material. PRs that look fully AI-generated with little author engagement may be closed, and AI agents should never ping maintainers.

evidence.quote: We are not opposed to the use of AI tools in generating PRs, but recommend the following:
Only submit a PR if you are able to debug and own the changes yourself - review all generated code to understand every detail
Be upfront about AI usage and summarise what was AI-generated
AI agents should never tag or ping maintainers
PR authors are also responsible for disclosing any copyrighted materials in submitted contributions.
